questions_and_answers.question_text: Zhèi liǎngnián, nǐmende shōurù zěnmeyàng?

answers.answer_text: What has your income been like the past couple of years?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Zhèi liǎngnián, nóngyè shēngchǎn qíngkuàng bú cuò, shōurù yě hái hǎo.

answers.answer_text: The past couple of years, agricultural production conditions have been pretty good, and our income has been all right, too.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Tāde shuōfǎ wǒ méi tīngdǒng, nǐ tīngmíngbai le ma?

answers.answer_text: I didn't understand the way he said that. Did you understand it?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Méiyou, wǒ yě méi tīngmíngbai, érqiě zhèige tímù yě tài nán le.

answers.answer_text: No, I didn't understand it either. Moreover this topic is too hard.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Xué pīnyīn yě hǎo, bù xué pīnyīn yě hǎo, Zhōngguo zì zǒng děi xué.

answers.answer_text: Whether you study romanization or not, you'll always have to study Chinese characters.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Shì a, zhèiyàng Zhōngguo wénhuà cái néng bǎochíxiaqu.

answers.answer_text: Yes, this is the only way Chinese culture can continue to be preserved.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Jiāli láodònglì duō, shēnghuó yě jiu huì hǎo yìdiǎnr.

answers.answer_text: If a family has more manpower, then it follows that life will be a little better.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Kěshi xiànzài rénkǒu duō bù yídìng yǒu shénme hǎochu.

answers.answer_text: But now it's not necessarily an advantage to have a lot of people.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Zài nàr xiě zìde nèige rén shi bu shi tā zhàngfu?

answers.answer_text: Is that person writing over there her husband?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Zhèng shi tā!

answers.answer_text: That's him all right!

questions_and_answers.question_text: Gōngshāngyè fādá yǒu shénme hǎochu? Nǎli dōu nàme zāng!

answers.answer_text: What benefit is there in having a flourishing industry and commerce? It's so dirty everywhere!

questions_and_answers.question_text: Zhèi yìdiǎn wǒ bù tóngyì, gōngshāngyè fādá yǒu bù shǎo hǎochu.

answers.answer_text: I don't agree with that. There are a lot of benefits to having a flourishing industry and commerce.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Tā wèishénme zǎohūn?

answers.answer_text: Why did she get married early?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Qùnián tā fùqin sǐ le, méi rén zhàogu ta, zhǐ hǎo jiéhūn le.

answers.answer_text: Last year her father died and there was no one to take care of her. All she could do was get married.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Duōshù rén dōu xǐhuan zìyóu.

answers.answer_text: Most people like freedom.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Kěshi, bú shi hěn duō rén néng dédào zìyóu.

answers.answer_text: But not many people can obtain freedom.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Wèile néng hùxiāng zhàogu, tāmen yìjiā sāndài zhù zài yìqǐ.

answers.answer_text: All three generations live together so that they can take care of each other.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Tīngshuō cóngqián, nǐmen zhèli yǒu hěn duō yǒu yìside fēngsú.

answers.answer_text: I've heard that in the past you had a lot of interesting customs here.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Shì a. Hòulái gōngshāngyè fādá le, fēngsú yě gǎibiàn le.

answers.answer_text: Yes. Later, when industry and commerce developed, customs changed, too.
